title: Independent singlet–triplet thermochemistry of an oxindole–acrylonitrile EDA complex
difficulty_reasons: The state identities and geometries are fixed, but the agent must independently choose a defensible electronic-structure/thermochemistry route, validate two states, and test the authors' qualitative charge-transfer hypothesis.

paper.title: Base-Promoted C3-Cyanoalkylation of Oxindoles With Substituted Acrylonitriles Enabled Through EDA Complexes

data.description: Complete 36-atom XYZ geometries for the singlet and triplet anionic complex, with charge and multiplicity in each file.

required_deliverables.description: Auditable protocol, state thermochemistry, validation, gap, charge-transfer assessment and limitations.
